name: Pre-registered walk-forward test of the ranking
data: 66 US-listed stocks (26 thesis companies and 40 unrelated control companies), daily closing prices, 2016-03-30 to 2026-07-31
rule: All five criteria must pass. Failing any one means the result is NOT ESTABLISHED.

criteria.criterion: Works in most periods: positive in at least 80% of the six-month windows in the development period
Holds up on later data: positive on the 2023 to 2026 test period and better than the simple baseline rule
Works outside my thesis: positive on a control group of 40 unrelated large companies
Survives the multiple-testing check: the result is large enough given how many variations were tried
Survives a resampling check: block bootstrap p-value below 0.05

selection_effect_note: Ranking versus holding the same 26 companies in equal amounts, same dates, development period.
amendment: One amendment is disclosed in the protocol: the development period start moved from 2016-03-30 to 2017-04-03 because no company had the required 250 days of price history before then. It was made after the first run and before any candidate was selected, and applies to every candidate equally.
follow_up: A drafted proposal to stop ranking and hold every eligible company in equal amounts, keeping the safety gates. The ranking code has not been removed. Since 2026-08-31 the automated run has had the equal-amounts approach switched on in the practice account, behind a setting that can be turned off.
